docs.text:
Dutt’s prose English version of the Viṣṇu Purāṇa, the Purāṇa of the five marks (creation, dissolution, genealogies, Manvantaras and dynasties), based on Wilson’s translation (Calcutta, 1896). Listed in the catalogue of the Rare Book Society of India.

From Internet Archive · Public domain in India

Scanned and hosted by the Internet Archive. Item: VishnuPurana - English - MN Dutt · MN Dutt, 479 scanned pages. Published 1896; Manmatha Nath Dutt died 1912 (translating from Wilson, died 1860); the text is ancient; public domain in India.

This book is not stored in this library: its pages are shown from the Internet Archive when they are opened, in this library's own viewer, and each chapter ends with this credit. The pages are shown as scans in this library's viewer (zoom, pan, thumbnails); the machine reading of these scans is not good enough to be shown as text.
